notes.isolation: Every probe ran with HOME redirected into a throwaway sandbox; the host's real ~/.claude files were never read or written. Auth traveled by inherited environment only.
notes.cross_source_order_evidence: Four probe pairs fired standard-source-first 2-3 ms apart, but a start/finish-timestamp probe (project hook sleeping 300 ms, relay hook sleeping 0 ms) showed relay STARTING before project in 1 of 4 runs, with the two hooks running concurrently. Cross-source order is typical, not contractual; only the merge (all sources fire) is.
notes.tui_per_turn_evidence: Two turns in one TUI session: turn 1 fired 1 Stop with reply rendered (22.6 s), turn 2 fired 1 Stop with reply rendered (15.1 s); TUI screen showed (running stop hook) on both.
notes.degraded_path_hazard: On runs where the model's tool calls were permission-DENIED (no allowlist, headless), one run out of two produced an extra Stop firing. Mechanism unexplained; not reachable in the NEEDLE fleet (claude-print.yaml passes --dangerously-skip-permissions). The single-fire poller tolerates it: first payload → transcript retry/fallback, watchdog bounds the session.
notes.print_mode_tool_use_evidence: Two sequential permitted Bash rounds in one -p run: exactly 1 Stop at the turn's true end (payload last_assistant_message: DONE, stop_hook_active: false).
